name: Nurses and care managers: permanent roles
goal: Book a 15 minute intro call with Tristan about permanent roles

steps.brief: Lead with their registration (RGN, RMN), specialism and location. Permanent roles in private hospitals and nursing homes, or registered and deputy manager roles. Ask for a 15 minute call.
Short nudge. One concrete, true benefit such as being matched to homes near them. Same ask. No salary promises.
Offer an alternative: reply with the kind of setting and hours they want and Tristan will look for it.
Polite last note, no pressure, door left open.
